notes.title: Escape The Metro Ticket Inspector GameMode!
notes.content:
- ZombieSurvivalGm is now Escape The Metro Ticket Inspector GM
- Kill the ticket inspectors in waves to earn money with which you can open doors to buy new weapons
- Ticket Inspectors have 4 spawn points per carrige, each will spawn the wave index amount of ticket inspectors at each spawn point ie Wave1 (1 per spawn point so total 4), Wave2 (2 per spawn point so total 8) ect...
- When a new Carrige is opened 4 more spawn points will be added

notes.title: Improved Spectator
notes.content:
- When in spectator mode you can now press "P" (Will change) to spectate another player

- Now when you die, you will be teleported into the "deathRoom" and you will be set into spectator mode which currently allows you to specate "Dead" players in the "deathRoom". // This will be fixed soon

notes.title: Late Joiners Update!
notes.content:
- Joining a match after its begun or after disconnecting from said game should now work fine.
- Creating a new match / lobby should also work fine now
- There are some UI Update issues I am aware of ie scoreboard might not update correctly for late joiners but that should be all. Please let me know if you experience any issues

notes.title: General Fixes
notes.content:
- If a player dies to another player with a key the key will "Drop" under them
- If a player commits suicide ie out of bounds the key will spawn in the managers office

- Items can now be switched from "E" and "Q" which will increase or decrease the index respectively

- Weapons will automatically reaload when ammo is depleated

notes.title: Bank Robbery!
notes.content:
- On bank manager death a yellow key will be dropped, it can be picked up by walking over it and equipped like normal items ie alpha 1, 2, 3 ect..
- Once the key is equipped walk over to the vault door in the bank to open it up. Inside you will find money (money can be picked up by walking over it)
- Once all the money has been collected and there are no more players in the vault room the bank will reset

notes.title: Bank Ai Updates
notes.content:
- When a player damages the bank manager the manager will hide and the player / players will be added to a enemy list that contains all players that have damaged the current bank manager.

- When the bank manager is damaged the bank doors will close and turrets will target any players in range untill the enemy player/players have been eliminated after which the doors will open and the manager and turrets will become passive

notes.title: Weapons System, Money System and Shop system Updates

[b][u]WeaponSystem[/u][/b]

   - No default weapons on spawn, they must be purchased

[b][u]MoneySystem[/u][/b]
   - On Start Game each player will recieve 1000$
   - On Death:
      - Victim will lose all weapons and 1/3 of their money
      - Attacker will gain the whole value of the victims money aswell as the sum of the victims
        weapons prices

[b][u]ShopSystem[/u][/b]
   - Shop is accessable from the "Phone" 
      - Phone can be toggled from the "F" key and there will be an "App" to open for the shop
